concept_options.title: One Line of Light
concept_options.hook: A warm glow appears on a bare wall… then the source.
concept_options.visual_approach: stillness → reveal. Open on the wall light-spill (IMG_8209/8211), slow 60fps-to-30fps slow-mo tilt up to the walnut body, canopy-to-tip hero (IMG_8205), end on full hero frame + name/CTA. Warm Japandi grade (~2900K look), soft grain, thin sans-serif type, 3 word cards max.
key_points: The light is warm, soft and diffused
concept_options.cta: Shop the pendant / DM to order
grounded_in: shoot the effect not the bulb
concept_options.why_this_works: Feeling-first opening in the first 1.5s, product reveal earns attention; uses the footage's best frame (the wall glow).

concept_options.title: Grain & Glow
concept_options.visual_approach: intimacy → payoff. Punch-in crops (4K source allows 2x) on wood grain at the base, the glowing slot, the canopy; match-cut along the vertical line; slow push-ins; payoff wide. Rich warm-brown grade, macro feel, serif + sans pairing.
concept_options.why_this_works: Sells material quality, which differentiates from cheap linear LEDs.

concept_options.title: The Line
concept_options.visual_approach: urgency → resolution. Beat-synced cuts every 0.4–0.8s, the light line locked to the same screen position across shots, white-flash/light-leak transitions, bold kinetic type stomps; ends on a held hero shot. Higher-contrast cool-to-warm grade.
concept_options.why_this_works: Maximum scroll-stop energy; short loopable runtime boosts replays.

selected_concept.rationale: User said 'Do your best' — agent's recommendation applied: Concept A with a short beat-cut energy passage borrowed from Concept C.

stages.approach: Trim selects from supplied clips; pick 2-3 music candidates for user approval.

tools.why_this_provider: HyperFrames available; Remotion deps not installed

stages.approach: Atelier (hand-authored) composition: clips + kinetic type + grade + music.

approval.user_notes: 'Do your best' — full creative delegation; neutral text (no brand name supplied).
